notes: The first raid tier (opens 9 December 2026). size and log_zone are sourced facts: Onyxia's Lair is 40 and the combat log names it "Onyxia's Lair"; the other two stay null until the client data names them (tenet 8). opens is the phases.json phase each raid opens with (forever-raid-phases.json patches raid:onyxias-lair to raids-1; Blizzard's What's Next recap names all three for 9 December); a guild can post a raid only on or after that day. Dungeon runs and guild events live in events.json. Each raid's bosses and loot are not curated here: pipeline raid-bosses ties them to the client's own Map, DungeonEncounter and Journal rows by these names and writes data/builds/<build>/raid-bosses.json (1.60.1.70790 names neither Barrow Deeps nor Hyjal Summit, and ships no Dungeon Journal).
